info.title: Laji API
info.description:
## Authentication

This API requires an **Access Token**. To obtain a token:
1. [Send a `POST` request with your email address to the `/api-user` endpoint](https://api.laji.fi/openapi#/API%20user/ApiUsersController_register).
2. An access token will be sent to your email.

Include the token in all requests using the HTTP header: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`

Here on the API frontpage, you can configure the **Access Token**, **Person-Token**, and **Accept-Language** globally using the **Authorize** button below.

---

- **Additional API documentation:**

---

## Support

If you have any questions, contact us at **helpdesk@laji.fi**.

operation.description: Requires that API key has load permissions. Note that you can only delete documents from the source that is defined by access_token

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: Normally sourceId is received via the API key. By giving this parameter you can override the sourceId. API key must have permissions to use that sourceId.

200.description: Accepted delete request. Does not neccesarilly mean there was anything to delete or that delete has gone through yet. Returns "ok"

400.description: Data was not accepted. Message tells why.

429.description: Too many pending requests for the access_token; max is 12

500.description: Service is in unknown erroneous state.
